documents.title: Carve-out completed — PAI Partners 67%, Fresenius 33%
documents.excerpt: The former Vamed rehabilitation business operates as VITREA, owned 67% by PAI Partners and 33% by Fresenius; standalone finance, HR and IT replace transitional services through FY2027.

documents.title: Nine Paracelsus rehabilitation clinics integrated (2025)
documents.excerpt: Nine rehabilitation clinics acquired from Paracelsus add German inpatient rehab capacity; their occupancy ramp-up is the key FY2027 volume assumption (planning model).

documents.title: High double-digit EUR million investment programme
documents.excerpt: Investment in outpatient rehab, clinic modernisation and digital therapy; the FY2027 plan carries about EUR 86M of capex (planning model).

documents.title: First DRV regional rate contracts settled at +4.5%
documents.excerpt: DRV daily-rate increases of about 4.5% against a tariff wage round of about 5% — the price-versus-wage gap decides the FY2027 margin (planning assumption).

documents.title: Further acquisitions under review
documents.excerpt: Acquisitions are under review; the plan keeps an M&A-ready baseline of care days, revenue per care day and EBITDA per clinic and country.
